title: Trans-EnV: A Framework for Evaluating the Linguistic Robustness of LLMs Against English Varieties

bias_targets.methodology: Transforming standard benchmark QA datasets from Standard American English (SAE) into 38 non-standard English varieties (18 regional dialects and 20 ESL varieties) using a custom framework (Trans-EnV), and measuring the performance degradation (accuracy drop) of LLMs on these transformed datasets compared to the original SAE versions.
